modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Interpret information from various views, projection, 2D and 3D shapes

pcs.pc_description: interpret engineering drawing's uniqueness, dimensions and important features in 2D and 3D shapes
identify the difference between 2D and 3D shapes
explain difference between first angle projection and third angle projection in mechanical engineering drawing
interpret all the 3 axes (x, y and z axis) and geometrical shapes (cones, cylinder, sphere, cuboid, etc) on to a 2D and 3D projection
identify details of the machine component which are not clearly visible by interpreting section views
interpret Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerencing (GD&T) symbols in the drawings

interpret symbols of Radius, controlled radius, spherical radius, diameter, spherical diameter, square, counterbore, spotface, depth, countersink, “by”, maximum dimension, minimum dimension, reference, dimension origin etc
identify the sequence of operations which enables the selection and prioritization of the datums
read and interpret information from Tolerance Zone boundaries for part features in terms of shape and size
observe any modification, changes required in the drawing and communicate the same to the concerned team in the organization
store the drawings in an easily accessible place, avoiding damage from moisture, chemicals and fire

pcs.pc_description: interpret the vehicle drawings, testing sheet and coordinate with the superior for confirming the testing tasks and type of tests required to be conducted on the component or on the vehicle
identify, select and arrange the testing equipment, measuring instruments, gauges, parts etc. required during the testing process
check the tools, gauges and testing appratus for defects and calibration status before use
identify the testing parameters which need to be measured during the test procedure

modules.module_title: Perform inspection and repairing of vehicle and its components

pcs.pc_description: follow safety practices recommended by organisation during inspection and testing process
conduct test drive to assess the need for repairs, calibration or any other adjustments in the electrical and mechanical components of the vehicle
dismantle and reassemble aggregates of the vehicle for fault diagnosis
conduct visual inspection of the bundled wiring, circuits, Integrated Circuits (IC's), Printed Circuit Boards (PCB's), wiring harnesses etc. for wear and tear, damage etc.
check the connections of the instruments like sensors, actuators, instrument clusters, ECU, motors and other electronic circuits
calibrate, align and adjust the settings of vehicle components as per the SOP and organisational standards
ensure part clearances as specified in the Work Instructions (WI)/Standard Operating Processes (SOP)

modules.module_title: Test vehicle and its components for faults in laboratory

pcs.pc_description: set the test apparatus as per the selected testing process and SOPs/WI

connect the various data capturing meters and gauges such as load cells, pneumatic/PLC testing gauges, strain gauges, displacement transducers, accelerometers, GPS data collection devices and data loggers to capture the data points
diagnose faults in the various sensors, actuators, power supply lines, electronic circuits and aggregates etc. in a vehicle by following senior's instructions
conduct various tests as per Automotive Industry Standard (AIS) 38, 39, 40, 41, 48, 49 and short circuit/open circuit test under the supervision of the Electric Vehicle test supervisor
record observations/ readings as per the parameters mentioned in the testing manual/WI
make minor modification in test setup/ vehicle/component under testing to take reading under different scenarios as per the requirement
conduct battery tests like abuse, altitude, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (SoH)
observe any deviations, noise or vibrations during the testing process and inform the Electric Vehicle test supervisor about the same
change or repair the vehicle components as per requirement

modules.module_title: Conduct testing of vehicle under running condition

pcs.pc_description: check motor and converter status, battery charge health and status, oil/lubricant level, cooling water level, tyre pressure, etc. before starting the on road testing of the vehicle prototype as per the checklist and testing manual

check working of all the safety features and system warning indicators showing system failures, loose connections, malfunctioning, etc. of vehicle as per the vehicle safety check list and testing manual
maintain and update the records of test results, data log etc. as per SOP
report the malfunctions/repairs in the vehicle beyond own scope to the concerned person
clean and store the tools, equipment and process auxiliaries as per organisational guidelines after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
perform scheduled checks, calibration and timely repairs for workshop tools, equipment and workstations
